raw_html: [[Legendary Magma Surge Guard|Legendary Magma Surge Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Magma Surge Guard]]:''' This item stores the immeasurable heat of the planet's molten mantle. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, superheated magma occasionally surges to the surface, causing a tremendous amount of Fire damage to the attacker.
